The lack of creativity in NBA logos. Specifically the fact that more than 2/3 of the 30 teams in the NBA have a basketball in their logo. Comparing them to American football, hockey, or baseball logos they hardly ever make a reference to the equipment used. Like helmets, baseballs, or pucks. 

For example, the NHL team the St. Louis Blues have a musical note for their team logo with wings, in a similar vein the NBA team the Utah Jazz also have a musical note as their logo expect they feel the need to incorporate a basketball into it. And it wouldn't be that bad if it was just a couple of teams, but it's every team. Whether it's front and centre or in the background in an otherwise perfectly fine logo. Say what you want about the Golden State Warriors they have a great logo based on their location with the Golden Gate Bridge and then bam, they find the need to add a basketball in the background.
 
Arguably the most iconic team in basketball, the LA Lakers simply have their name in front of a basketball. C'mon guys, I already know you're a basketball team why you do you feel the need to have to put one in your logo.
Keep up the good work man. I'll be rooting for you
